findings.message: Breaking Type Change. `hostContext` is a required field on the exported `RuntimeContext` interface. `metadata`, by comparison, is optional. Any object literal typed as `RuntimeContext` outside the places this PR updates will stop compiling. This PR already had to patch one such literal (`minimalContext` in `assertType`). Likely affected code includes test helpers, mock contexts in extension packages, and third-party hosts. This makes a feature listed under "Added" a breaking change for TypeScript consumers. I can't confirm from the diff whether other literals exist in the repo. Two fixes are possible: make the field optional, as `RuntimeContextLike` already does, and read it with `?? {}`. Or document the change as breaking.
